title: RendererInterface
description: The CLI contract between worker and engine. Informational (not a validation schema): both sides are tested against the contract fixture in CI.

inputs.edit_plan: <video-dir>/edit_plan.json (validated, all asset paths filled, paths relative to video-dir)
inputs.captions: from the plan, never from the .srt

exit_codes.nonzero: failure with ONE actionable reason on stderr

routing.auto: ffmpeg iff the plan uses only: cuts, crossfade/fade/fade_to_black, Ken Burns / static stills, plain caption preset, audio mix, and no overlay components; otherwise remotion
routing.pin_ffmpeg: plans requiring more MUST fail with the list of offending items (capability enforcement, not degradation)
